executive_summary: On May 22, 2026, OFAC added 9 individuals to the SDN list, primarily targeting entities in Lebanon with ties to SDGT and IFSR programs. The additions highlight the ongoing efforts to counter terrorist financing and sanctions evasion. The majority of the added individuals have connections to Lebanon, with some also linked to Iran.

risk_implications.description: The addition of 9 individuals to the SDN list, primarily with ties to Lebanon and the SDGT program, poses a significant risk to global security and financial systems due to potential involvement in terrorist financing and sanctions evasion.

The ongoing efforts to counter sanctions evasion and terrorist financing highlight the need for continued vigilance in monitoring and reporting suspicious activities, particularly in high-risk regions like Lebanon.

program_highlights.note: All 9 added individuals have ties to the SDGT program, emphasizing the ongoing concerns about terrorist financing and the need for continued countermeasures.
One individual, Sheibani Mohammad Reza Raouf, has ties to the IRAN program, highlighting the ongoing risks associated with Iranian sanctions evasion and terrorist financing.

One individual, Sheibani Mohammad Reza Raouf, has ties to the IFSR program, posing a significant risk to global security and financial systems due to potential involvement in sanctions evasion and terrorist financing.
